title: The BJP IT Cell in 30 seconds
subject: politics
native_material: messages, phones, org charts, filings and platform takedowns
metaphors: a forward travelling down a chain to your family group

concept.logline: How a political message reaches your family group, and who else plays the game.
concept.central_question: Where did that forward come from?
concept.claim: The BJP built a booth-by-booth phone network; the party president said it could make any message viral; every side has been caught.

scenes.narration: That forward in your family WhatsApp group? Some, reportedly, start in a party office.
scenes.graphic: Chat: Family group | them: fwd: SHARE THIS BEFORE IT GETS DELETED!! · me: Is this true? | app: whatsapp

scenes.narration: For 2019, the BJP planned a volunteer per polling booth. Reportedly, 900,000.
scenes.graphic: Flowchart: Central IT cell → State units → Booth volunteers → Your family group | The chain the BJP planned for 2019 | badge: reported | logo: whatsapp

scenes.narration: Amit Shah once told volunteers any message could go viral, true or false. He added they shouldn't.
scenes.graphic: Newscard: 22 Sept 2018 | “Any message can go viral, true or false” | Amit Shah to BJP social media volunteers in Kota; he added it shouldn't be done | The Quint | badge: verified

scenes.narration: But in 2019, Facebook took down 687 Congress-linked pages, and 15 tied to a BJP-leaning firm.
scenes.graphic: Units: Congress-linked 687 vs BJP-leaning 15 | Facebook takedowns, 1 April 2019 | one square = one page or account removed | badge: verified | logo: facebook

scenes.narration: Now, under a new chief, it's memes and rap, reports say.
scenes.graphic: Tornsplit: smartphone | MEMES AND RAP | Since Aug 2026 · Newslaundry | badge: reported
